Doorstep/Curbside Delivery is used for heavier items (over 150 lbs). This service starts at $99 for the first large item, with a maximum charge of $198 per order regardless of how many large items you're ordering. We partner with SEKO and BTX for these deliveries.
In-Home Delivery & Setup is our optional upgraded service that includes scheduled delivery, assembly, and setup. Shipping fees are non-refundable as they cover the cost of transit and setup.
